steps.detail: All layer PNGs, items, and linked place symbols match

friction.name: Starter-map entry
friction.evidence: A blank authoring journey requires Datei → Neue Karte → Leere Karte after the starter opens

friction.name: Large landmass by hand
friction.evidence: The 400 px brush still needs many broad passes and coastal corrections
friction.workaround: Use several sizes and the eraser

friction.name: Raster paths
friction.evidence: Roads and waterways are still paint strokes, so a bend cannot be selected and moved
friction.workaround: Keep them on Flüsse & Wege and use Undo/eraser

friction.name: Stamp variation default
friction.evidence: The stamp tool starts with random size and rotation enabled
friction.workaround: Turn it off for a reproducible map

friction.name: Painted title
friction.evidence: The project title and large TURTONIA map lettering are entered separately

friction.name: Separate exports
friction.evidence: The PNG has no editable place lore; the rdmap file must also be retained
